_comment: Control messages the renderer sends on the live socket (/ws/transcribe) besides audio frames. The backend (backend/main.py LIVE_TAKE_CONTROL_TYPE, _ws_recv_live) and the renderer (frontend/src/take-collection.ts) each check their constants against this file, so a rename on one side fails its suite instead of silently dropping the message.

takeUpdate._comment: The take's collection changed after the socket opened: a screen take whose screen session could not start is a voice take (desktop screen-mode:voice-take). The backend re-files the recovery sidecar; leaving 'screen' drops the screen session id.
